name: message-actions
description: The action row under an AI reply — copy, good / bad feedback as toggle buttons, and regenerate

meta.name: MessageActions
meta.description: The action row under an AI reply — copy, good / bad feedback as toggle buttons, and regenerate

props.name: copyValue
props.description: The text the Copy button copies. Omit to hide Copy.

props.name: feedback
props.description: Controlled rating: `good`, `bad` or `null`. Pressing the active rating again clears it.

props.name: onFeedbackChange
props.description: Called with the new rating (or `null` when cleared). The rating buttons render when this or `feedback` is set; a rating also announces "Thanks for your feedback".

props.name: onRegenerate
props.description: Called by the Regenerate button. Omit to hide it.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for the component’s user-visible strings (i18n).
props.type: { group?: string; good?: string; bad?: string; regenerate?: string; recorded?: string }

examples.title: Copy, rate and regenerate
examples.code: <MessageActions copyValue="Refunds are available for 30 days." onFeedbackChange={() => {}} onRegenerate={() => {}} />

whenToUse: Under each assistant message: copy the reply, rate it, or ask for another attempt
whenNotToUse: Stopping a response that is still generating — use AiStatus with onStop
Actions on a non-AI item — use ButtonGroup or a Menu

antiPatterns.bad: Swapping the rating button’s label to "Good response recorded"
antiPatterns.good: Keep a stable name and expose the choice with aria-pressed; the component announces the confirmation once
antiPatterns.why: A name that changes on press reads as a different control; aria-pressed is how toggle buttons report state

related.name: AiStatus
related.reason: AiStatus covers the in-progress phase; MessageActions appears once the reply is complete

intent.a11yRationale: A named group of real buttons. Good and Bad are toggle buttons (aria-pressed), so the chosen rating is exposed as state rather than by a changing label, and choosing one announces "Thanks for your feedback" once through the shared announce() region. Icon buttons carry accessible names and meet the coarse-pointer target size

flexibility.note: Each action renders only when its prop is set
Two-state good / bad toggles; do not repurpose them for other choices
